messages:
elaine: Quick thought — propose a compact 30m webinar focused on 'micro-demos' (3x 7-min demos + 7m Q&A). keeps ops light and makes lead follow-up granular. thoughts?
ash: love that. shorter sessions convert better for execs. we need a tight run for transitions.
jonah: 👍 agree. can we tie each demo to a specific ICP/use case? e.g., dev platform, search/semantic, and customer-facing summarization.
mike: if we go micro, landing page should let attendees pick which demo they care about so we can route leads post-event. add a checkbox per demo.
lina: audience segmentation + post-webinar tags work. Sales wants the demo interest tag in HubSpot.
elaine: good call. speaker ask: ash to own dev platform demo, jonah to do semantic search, mike to run the summarization / cost story?
ash: I can do dev platform but need a short script + 3 slide cue card per demo. nobody wants a 20-slide deep dive.
mike: can do summarization, will include 1 metric slide (latency/cost tradeoff) and 1 live prompt.
jonah: semantic search will be live rerank + embeddings. need a deterministic dataset and a canned prompt file so demos are repeatable.
elaine: action items: 1) speakers -> write 250-300 word abstract + 3 cue bullets by Thu EOD. 2) ops -> rehearsal times + recording failover. 3) growth -> landing page with demo-selection checkboxes.
nash: what about demo fallback? if model instability happens we need a recording swap plan. rehearsal-bot: Reminder: rehearse in staging org at 2025-05-08T17:00Z. please confirm.
elaine: fallback plan: keep a 90s pre-recorded clip for each demo ready in case of live issues. slide 1 should have 'switch to video' cue.
mike: agreed. also add a network-check step 5m before go-time: `curl https://demo-api.redwood.test/health` — if > 200ms, switch to recorded.
oneliner: (this is a short note)
jonah: routing — after the event, send rows to HubSpot with fields: email, demo_interest (dev/search/summarize), company_size, lead_score. who owns mapping?
lina: growth owns mapping; sales ops needs the schema by Wed.
elaine: run-of-show draft: 00:00–00:03 intro & housekeeping, 00:03–00:12 demo 1, 00:12–00:21 demo 2, 00:21–00:30 demo 3 + 00:30–00:37 moderated Q&A (wrap by 37m). keep each demo to 6m live + 1m transition.
ash: can we have a 'panelist mic-check' 10m before? also assign a clock operator to call time.
mike: i'll volunteer as clock and handoff engineer. will monitor logs and have a hotkey to swap to recording.
elaine: perfect. who moderates Q&A? jonah?
jonah: I can moderate. will collect upvotes in Slido and surface top 6.
lina: for lead routing, requirement: UTM and checkbox data, plus a final question on intent (pilot/POC/eval). makes follow-up prioritized.
elaine: PR/announce plan — short multi-line post on X, and an email to existing users with 'select your demo' CTA. growth to draft copy.
ash: slide deck notes: each demo should include 1) problem, 2) how we solve it (one screenshot), 3) 1 metric, 4) CTA. one slide per demo max.
jonah: rehearsal checklist: 1) run slide deck+video transitions 2) verify demo data seed 3) do the `curl` latency test 4) rehearse the recording swap 5) confirm HubSpot mapping 6) check speaker mics & Zoom region.
rehearsal-bot: rehearsal scheduled: 2025-05-08 17:00 UTC. 6 participants confirmed. link: https://zoom.redwood/webinar-rehearse-825
mike: small note — ensure the demo environment uses a perm token with read-only data and a short TTL. security ops to approve by Fri.
elaine: timeline: abstracts Thu, draft landing page Fri, rehearsals next Thu, final deck Mon before event.
lina: will prep the HubSpot property sheet and share by Wed.
ash: will upload cue cards to the drive and leave speaker notes <= 3 bullets per demo.
jonah: final ask — can we capture a short 30s post-demo clip for social? pipeline that into growth.
mike: yes, I'll record a clean clip during the rehearsal to repurpose.
elaine: sweet. last item — who will do post-webinar emails? growth + demand gen (mike + lina).
lina: noted. i'll own the first 24h follow-up sequence.
elaine: thanks all. ping this thread when abstracts are live. :thumbsup:
